text: The user's GitHub handle is tamirtm. Repos: tamirtm/TestingF (main dev workbench) and tamirtm/hello-world (scratch repo, README only).
The user makes Magic: The Gathering proxy cards printed at MakePlayingCards (MPC) using MPC Autofill.
The user does packaging and branding for WPG Proxy Prints: card box lids, box wraps and round seal stickers.
The user drafts Market Intelligence Scopes of Work (SOW) and cover emails for WTC Winnipeg from discovery-call notes.
The user's Claude connectors: Google Drive, Microsoft 365, Notion, GitHub, Expedia, Tripadvisor. Stripe and IBISWorld need re-authorization.
Anything that sends, posts, spends money or writes to a remote must run with DRY_RUN=1 until the user explicitly says go.
Use kebab-case names for decks, projects, skills and workflows.
TestingF build pipeline: find -> vet -> vendor -> study -> adapt -> build -> test.

TestingF layout: vendor/<name> pinned upstream (never edited, gitignored, pinned in vendor/manifest.tsv); projects/<name> adapted builds with README, tests, NOTICE.md; lab/skills/<name> skills under test with evals; lab/workflows/<name> automations with run.sh, fixtures, expected, test.sh; scripts/ tooling.

Check the license before copying code: scripts/license-check.sh vendor/<name>. MIT/BSD/ISC/Unlicense ok with copyright in NOTICE.md; Apache-2.0 ok, keep LICENSE/NOTICE and mark changed files; MPL file-level copyleft; LGPL link freely; GPL/AGPL stop and ask; no license means read-only, never copy.
Reverse engineering only for open source, own, licensed code or interoperability. Never bypass licence checks, DRM, auth, or extract secrets/keys.
Every project change ships with a test. Run scripts/test-all.sh before saying done. Never skip, delete or weaken a test or claim an unrun pass.
Secrets come only from env vars, never committed; .env files are not read. vendor/** is never edited; no git push --force.
scripts/vendor.sh <git-url> [name] [ref] clones at a pinned commit and records the license in vendor/manifest.tsv; scripts/vendor.sh --restore re-fetches all pinned upstreams.

scripts/test-all.sh is the single CI entry point; runs each projects/* and lab/workflows/* suite: test.sh, else npm test, else uv run --with pytest pytest -q, else cargo test, else go test. CI is GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest with setup-uv.
scripts/eval-skill.sh <name> runs claude plugin eval in lab/skills/<name>: 3 runs per case, no-skill baseline, US$2 cost cap, threshold 0.8, no publish.
Toolchain: Python via uv, Node via npm, Rust cargo, Go go; Playwright+Chromium for UI tests; RE tools radare2, binwalk, gdb, strace, ltrace, xxd, 7z, js-beautify, webcrack, jadx.
Vendored mpc-autofill (github.com/chilli-axe/mpc-autofill @ ceb7c3b2f39b, AGPL) is studied for interoperability only (order.xml format); no code is copied.
projects/mpc-deck-builder (Python>=3.11, Pillow, CLI mpcdeck): deck list -> Scryfall lookup -> rendered card PNGs with 1/8 inch bleed -> order.xml for MPC Autofill.

Run: cd projects/mpc-deck-builder && uv run mpcdeck decks/<deck>.txt -o out/<deck> [--dpi 600] [--stock S30] [--foil] [--cardback f.png] [--art art] [--frames frames] [--custom custom] [--full-scans]. Use - for stdin.
Card spec: trim 2.48x3.46 in; output with bleed 2.72x3.70 in (0.12 in per side) = 816x1110 @300 DPI, 1632x2220 @600, 2176x2960 @800.
Deck lists accept '4 Name', '4x Name', '1 Sol Ring (C21) 263', 'A // B' double-faced/split, *F* foil markers, Deck/Sideboard/Commander headers and Archidekt tags; duplicate lines merge.

Overrides: art/<Card Name>.png|jpg replaces art; frames/<key>.png with key in W U B R G gold artifact land; fonts/regular|bold|italic.ttf; custom/<Card Name>.png finished card used as-is. Text positions are LAYOUT in mpcdeck/render.py.
Output out/<deck>/fronts, backs, cardback.png, order.xml with relative paths; run MPC Autofill from inside that folder. Needs network to api.scryfall.com and cards.scryfall.io.

Official MTG art, frames and text belong to Wizards of the Coast and artists; personal playtest proxies only. Cards for sale must use original frames and owned/licensed art. Never use --full-scans for cards to sell.
Scryfall art_crop is about 626 px wide, soft at 600+ DPI; upscale (e.g. Real-ESRGAN) into art/ for sharp prints.

Code map: cli.py orchestration, decklist.py parser, scryfall.py API+cache, render.py frames/text, bleed.py bleed, order.py order.xml and STOCKS; tests/ with offline fixture tests/fixtures/cards.json (11 tests passing 2026-10-24).

oss-adopt: shortlist up to 3 repos (stars, last commit, license, issues, fit); vendor + license-check + run upstream tests + skim install scripts; adapt lightest first: depend, wrap, copy files, fork; write NOTICE.md; hand off to build-test.

code-recon: scope check first; produce RECON.md (purpose, entry points, module map, data flow with file:line, side effects, tests, gotchas) and prove it with a test. JS: js-beautify/webcrack. Binaries: file, strings, xxd, binwalk, objdump, r2, readelf, strace. Formats: 3+ samples, diff, parser + round-trip test.
build-test: detect stack, install, build (fix root cause), add smoke test and change test, make test-all.sh pick it up, report pass/fail per suite with first error lines.

skill-lab: skill at lab/skills/<n>/skills/<n>/SKILL.md plus .claude-plugin/plugin.json; description says what and when; body under ~150 lines; at least 3 evals (should-trigger, hard case, should-not-trigger); one change per round, scores in CHANGELOG.md; must beat baseline.

workflow-lab: run.sh with DRY_RUN=1 default, scrubbed fixtures, expected outputs, test.sh, README listing trigger/inputs/outputs/side effects/env/schedule; idempotent with timestamped logs; headless Claude via claude -p --output-format json --max-turns N --max-budget-usd X.

mpc-deck: save list to decks/<kebab-name>.txt; defaults 600 DPI, S30, no foil; run mpcdeck; verify PNG counts and view one card; zip out/<deck>; tell user to run Autofill from inside the folder. Never fake output if Scryfall is blocked.

commit-msg: Conventional Commits '<type>(<scope>): <imperative <=60 chars>' plus 1-3 line why at 72 cols; types feat fix refactor docs test chore perf build ci; propose a split for mixed diffs; output only the message.
recon-mapper subagent: read-only (Read, Grep, Glob, Bash); returns Purpose, Entry points, Module map, Data flow with file:line, Side effects, How to run tests, Open questions.
lab/workflows/inbox-triage: ./run.sh <inbox> [dest] sorts text notes into finance, dev, meetings or review by keywords; moves files only when DRY_RUN=0.

Claude models (2026-10): claude-opus-5-5 default ($4/$20 per 1M), claude-sonnet-5-5 ($2/$10), claude-haiku-5-5 ($0.10/$0.50), claude-fable-5-1 most capable ($10/$50). All 1M context, 128K output. Use exact IDs with no date suffix.

Current Claude API: use thinking {type: adaptive} or omit; budget_tokens is rejected; control depth with output_config.effort (Opus 5.5 default medium); no assistant prefill; no temperature/top_p/top_k; forced tool_choice any/tool rejected on Opus 5.5/Sonnet 5.5; check stop_reason for refusal; stream large max_tokens.
For small local models, feed short numbered checklists (the SKILL.md bodies and handoff/system-prompt.md) rather than long prose.
New machine: git clone https://github.com/tamirtm/TestingF && cd TestingF && scripts/vendor.sh --restore && scripts/test-all.sh.
